title: Chapter 731
text:
After a few days of travel, the Blacklight Stealth arrived at its destination.

Outside the porthole was a planet. Green vegetation, yellow land, and blue ocean formed the surface of the planet, with the yellow color occupying the highest proportion.

Aurora looked down at the planet curiously.

"Philip, what planet is this?"

"Searching database … Search complete, hum …

Planet Nalun, coordinates: Star Zone 6 of the Colton Star Cluster of the Shattered Star Ring. Planet area code: S 0706812. Discovered and recorded by the Gorut Civilization. There are signs of civilization, but it is relatively backward and has yet to develop interstellar technology. Observation priority four, hum … "

Planet Nalun had a surface civilization, but their technology was still in the ancient era. There were no planes, cannons, or nuclear weapons, and they were far from the stage of space exploration.

Aurora was confused. "Why did Han Xiao bring us here?"

"He definitely has a reason. Let's ask him when we arrive." Fu Ding smiled.

Han Xiao was not on the spaceship at this time. The three of them were traveling in the spaceship, while he was running naked in the universe to expose himself to the cosmic radiation and obtain some attributes through the radiation absorption of the Void Star Pursuer. As such, the speed of the spaceship was much slower than the three of them.

The spaceship was suspended in the outer space of Planet Nalun. Not long after, the space beside it started to distort, and Han Xiao's figure jumped out from the Void Dimension. He shivered and hurriedly flew into the cabin.

"Hu …"

Stepping into the cabin, Han Xiao hurriedly exhaled and exhaled a scorching hot breath.

As soon as he left the vacuum environment, white smoke rose from his body with a sizzling sound, as if he was being cooked.

The cells in his body had absorbed a large amount of cosmic radiation, and his body was like a furnace. His skin was so hot that it could fry an egg.

Han Xiao opened the interface and looked at it with satisfaction.

"As expected of a mid-grade evolved species. The growth rate of this talent is not bad. As long as it accumulates for enough time, the bonuses will be very impressive."

After some tests, Han Xiao had already figured out the mechanism of the radiation absorption.

After evolving into a Void Star Pursuer, the cells in his body had been modified, and he now had the ability to absorb cosmic radiation. As long as his body was exposed to the universe for a certain period of time, he would be able to trigger the absorption of radiation, permanently increasing his strength, agility, and endurance by 1 to 3 points, or increasing his maximum energy by 5 to 10 points.

If he triggered Radiation Absorption multiple times within a certain period of time, the interval between the effects of this talent would become longer and longer. In other words, he would have to run naked in the universe for a longer period of time before he could increase his attributes again.

If he rested for more than a day, the interval between the effects of the talent would decrease, and he would return to his original state.

The absorption process could be broken down into three steps — absorption, storage, and digestion. Cells were not bottomless pits, and their storage and digestion abilities were limited. It was like eating. When cells were full, they needed time to digest, which was why this situation occurred.

This was a Species Innate Skill that could provide considerable benefits through the accumulation of time. He could become stronger just by hacking, so it was definitely profitable. Radiation Absorption was the Innate Skill that Han Xiao was most satisfied with at the moment.

At this time, the total bonus of this talent was + 16 Strength, + 13 Dexterity, + 21 Endurance, + 68 Energy, and a huge increase in attack power.

After returning to the cockpit, Han Xiao greeted the three of them.

"Sorry to keep you guys waiting. We can move now."

"What are we doing on this planet?" Aurora asked.

"Doing good deeds."

Han Xiao smiled and switched to manual pilot mode. The spaceship entered stealth mode and entered Planet Nalun's atmosphere before descending slowly.

This was the first place he chose to farm for talents. Planet Nalun had three continental plates, but only one of them had a civilization. The other two had not been discovered by the native civilizations. Even the age of navigation had not begun, so this civilization naturally did not know what the universe was like.

Other than the Gorut Civilization that discovered Planet Nalun, he should be the second person from the universe to visit this planet.

This civilization was inclined towards magic. Several kingdoms ruled the continent, and the system of kings and lords was mainly aristocratic. They fought against each other, and the most powerful kingdom was called "Ocean Lein".

In his previous life, players had discovered a talent mission here, and it was somewhat useful to Han Xiao.

The invisible spaceship descended to an altitude of one thousand meters. Under Han Xiao's control, it swept across the earth, and towns built with stone bricks passed by in his field of vision.

The surface civilization of Planet Nalun did not have the ability to discover interstellar spaceships.

The spaceship quickly circled around the continent and completed its scan. Philip huffed and puffed as he generated a map.

Whoosh —

The trees swayed, and the spaceship landed in the dense forest of a mountain range.

Han Xiao led the three of them down the spaceship and kept the spaceship in stealth mode to avoid being discovered by the natives of Planet Nalun.

Taking out the newly generated map, Han Xiao glanced at it and explained.

"The destination is nearby. This is the territory of the Ocean Lein Kingdom. We are going to a city called Stone Heart City. Let me take a look … Oh, it's that city."

Han Xiao pointed into the distance, and Hella and the other two looked in the direction he was pointing.

At the edge of the mountain range, there was a town built against the mountain. The city was built with gray bricks.

"Stay by my side and keep a low profile. If I don't ask you to do anything, don't do anything rash."

Han Xiao instructed carefully.

Grade A was a high-level combat power in the universe. It had the power to crush surface civilizations like this. No one on Planet Nalun could defeat them. If they were not careful, they could destroy a city.

In order to complete the mission, Han Xiao needed everyone to keep a low profile, at least on the surface.

Although they did not understand Han Xiao's intention, Hella and the other two nodded.

"Philip, simulate the appearance of the Nalun people."

A few mechanical balls rose and shot blue cone-shaped rays at Han Xiao and the other three.

Matrix data flashed, and a simple simulation illusion was quickly generated on the surface of the four of them, transforming them into the appearance of the Nalun people. The body structure of the Nalun people was similar to the human race. Their skin was darker, rougher, and had lines.

After adjusting the channel of the translator and everything was ready, Han Xiao led the three of them along the mountain path toward Stone Heart City.

…

The afternoon sun was lazy.

The four of them were extremely fast. Soon, they arrived at the scattered towns outside the city. Beside the road were plots of land reclaimed. Farmers were working hard in the fields, and the stench of some kind of animal dung floated in the air.

They were used to the magnificent scenery of the universe. At this time, they were enjoying the primitive scenery of the surface civilization. Even the advanced galactic civilizations had gone through such a period. The fire of civilization was weak at the beginning, but it grew under the care of generations.

Fighting in the universe every day, they would see either battleships or armor. Occasionally, they would come to such a backward surface civilization to relax.

There was no need to worry about enemies. They could do whatever they wanted here.

"The environment here is not bad. There is no industrial pollution." Han Xiao took a deep breath and shook his head. "Even the smell of feces is so fresh …"

"I feel that you are becoming more and more perverted recently," Fu Ding said honestly.

"No, no, you are better in this aspect."

After chatting for a while, they arrived at the entrance of Stone Heart City. The guards could not see through the camouflage technology. Han Xiao and the others blended into the crowd and entered the city.

What greeted them was a smelly hot wind. Noisy shouts violently crashed into their ears. In front of them were messy stone streets, backward town planning, and primitive natives.

"What are we going to do?" Aurora asked softly.

"You have the most questions. Just follow me and we will be done."

Han Xiao pulled Aurora's soft cheeks with two fingers and let go. Aurora covered her red face with tears.

"Sister, he bullied me." Aurora turned around and complained.

Hella did not look sideways, as if she did not see anything.

The few of them approached the notice board of the town. Philip translated the Nalun language into the common language, and Han Xiao looked at an old notice that had been posted for who knew how many years.

The content could be summarized as: A manor in Stone Heart City is haunted. A demon spirit has appeared. The manor owner wishes to hire someone to solve it.

This bounty had been around for a long time.

The location of the mission was a small manor. Han Xiao and the others expressed their intentions, and they were quickly warmly welcomed by the manor owner. They sat down in the main hall.

As soon as they sat down, the manor owner could not wait to speak.

"Great, someone is finally willing to help. This notice has been posted for a few years, and I have received at least a hundred people. Five of them claimed to be wizards, but none of them could solve the problem."

"Don't worry, we are different," Han Xiao said, and the translator translated his words into the Nalun language.

"Then … are you wizards?" The manor owner had a hopeful look on his face.

"You can say that. Tell me the details first."

"O-Okay …"

On Planet Nalun, there was a type of energy creature that was similar to a ghost. The natives called it a demon spirit. A few years ago, a demon spirit appeared in this manor and would occasionally appear at night.

The Supers on Planet Nalun were Magicians. The Nalun people called them 'Poposote', and the translator translated it as' wizard '. The Supers system here was very weak. The wizards mainly used magic potions or materials to cast spells. They were only D-Grade, but in the eyes of the natives, they were mysterious and powerful.

Getting rid of the demon spirits was the job of the wizards. However, a few decades ago, a large number of wizards had disappeared. It was very rare to see wizards now. Spells had lost their inheritance, and the Supers system was cut off. No one knew how to get rid of the demon spirits. They could only explore the Supers system again through obscure magic books.

Fortunately, the demon spirit in this manor was relatively weak, so the manor owner's family could still live here for a few years.

After the manor owner finished speaking, Han Xiao's interface showed a notification.

You have triggered the chain mission, Demon King of Planet Nalun!

Mission Introduction: You heard from others that the wizards on Planet Nalun disappeared for some reason. There seems to be more to this.

The first round of the mission requires you to get rid of the demon spirit in the manor.

Reward: 20 EXP

This was a chain mission. The reward for the first round was very little. In Han Xiao's previous life, the players had only discovered this place when they were exploring freely in Version 30.

Every civilization had a large number of trivial missions. This mission was very well hidden. In Han Xiao's previous life, a storyline player had coincidentally completed this mission and discovered that the reward was a talent that could increase mental resistance. Although Planet Nalun's power system was very weak, the reward was very good.

Now that the version had just started, the Black Star Corps had been cultivating leeks on a large scale. As a result, no one had explored Planet Nalun yet.

Because of the Soul Embryo, Han Xiao decided to get a mental resistance talent. Therefore, he came to this place that was not even as strong as the novice village.

He was clear about the mission process. It could save him a lot of time.

"Leave the demon spirit to us. We'll deal with it tonight."

As Han Xiao spoke, he glanced at the corner of the room. There was a transparent magic eyeball floating there, monitoring their conversation.

Only the manor owner did not know about the existence of this magic eyeball. When they first entered the room, Han Xiao and the others had noticed it immediately.

In the eyes of Supers at their level, this low-grade magic eyeball was like a living person squatting in the corner, mumbling, "You can't see me". It could only trick the air.

"Don't worry about it." Han Xiao waved his hand to stop Fu Ding. He knew who was watching this manor. Luring out the watcher was the key step of the mission.

…

At the same time, in a secret gathering place under Stone Heart City.

There were no windows in the room. There were only a few kerosene lamps. In the darkness, a hoarse voice sounded.

"Guard Number 13 has reacted. Someone has accepted the reward of the manor and wants to deal with the demon spirit."

At this moment, another young voice sounded. He sounded helpless as he replied, "I'm afraid it's one of those lame amateurs who read a few witchcraft books and think they're wizards. Sigh, how can they handle demon spirits?"

"They said that they will move at night. Tomar, follow them."

"Got it. I will protect them in case they provoke the demon spirit and get hurt."

The conversation came to an end. The sound of gears moving could be heard in the room. It lasted for a while before it stopped.

…

Late at night, Han Xiao asked the manor owner and his family to leave. He then brought the three of them to the back of the manor.

There was an abandoned area surrounded by stone walls and fences. There were several locks on the door.

Using the key given by the manor owner to open the door, Han Xiao and the others walked in. Inside was an abandoned warehouse area with several granaries.

A cold and sticky aura floated in the air, as if there was an invisible air current gently brushing past their skin.

If an ordinary person was here, they would feel inexplicably nervous, as if there was a ghost.

However, it did not have any effect on Han Xiao and the others.

"There is a weak and abnormal mental signal here. I noticed it during the day," Fu Ding whispered. "Do you need me to deal with it?"

Demon spirits paled in comparison to a Psychic Grandmaster like him. Not to mention a single demon spirit, he could even get rid of a thousand demon spirits with a single thought.

"Let's wait for it to appear first."

Han Xiao shook his head and glanced in the direction of one of the granaries. In his senses, there was a living person squatting there. That was his target.

"Alright, we'll listen to you."

Fu Ding was helpless.

Although they had doubts in their hearts, they were now bodyguards. Their job was to follow Han Xiao everywhere.

Not far away, Tomar was carefully hiding behind one of the granaries with his back against the wall. He stuck his head out and observed Han Xiao and the others.

He was a youth wearing a black hooded outfit that covered his face. He was dressed like an assassin. There were several small bags on his belt that contained casting materials.

Seeing Han Xiao and the others looking left and right as if they were on an outing, Tomar could not help but roll his eyes in disdain.

They are too unprofessional. They don't even know how to set up spiritual stone powder in advance. Where did they get the confidence to help others get rid of a demon spirit? It seems like they won't be able to avoid suffering …

Just as he was thinking about it, a gust of cold wind blew. The dust on the ground was swept up like a tornado. A faint blue phantom appeared, and a mournful roar resounded in the air.

"Shit, this blue phantom demon spirit has mutated after not seeing it for a few years!"

Tomar was shocked when he saw the situation, and he started to feel anxious.

He had only learned magic for five years, and even he did not dare to guarantee that he would be able to protect himself from this demon spirit. Not to mention, there were four amateurs dragging him down.

Seeing that the four of them were not doing anything, Tomar cursed in his heart. He reached for his bag of casting materials and was about to rush out to help.

Pu!

Right at this moment, Fu Ding casually sent out a spiritual wave and hit the demon spirit.

The blue illusory spirit body shattered like a broken mirror, turning into blue snowflakes and disappearing without a trace.

At this moment, Tomar had just rushed out and was exposed to Han Xiao and the others. When he saw this scene, he froze on the spot.

What just happened? The demon … the demon spirit was destroyed in an instant?

Didn't Magi use magic potions to fight? What was the situation now? Why didn't the books mention it?
